name: Grain Term Structure: Does Carry Regime Predict Next Quarter?
description: Tests whether the current backwardation/contango regime in corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS) predicts the carry level one quarter (63 trading days) ahead. Uses binary regime classification (carry > 0 = backwardation, carry < 0 = contango). Outputs: carry persistence scatter, median forward carry by regime bars, forward carry distribution histogram, and regime statistics table. Event markers flag each regime flip.
source:
# Grain Term Structure: Does Carry Regime Predict Next Quarter?
# Binary regime: backwardation (carry > 0) vs contango (carry < 0)
# Forward horizon: 63 trading days (~1 quarter)
# Assets: ZC (corn), ZS (soybeans) — symmetric study

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
carry = cont.carry
ts = index().value

# --- Carry Regime ---
# Backwardation = carry > 0 (front premium), Contango = carry < 0 (front discount)
is_backwardation = is_valid(carry) and carry > 0
is_contango = is_valid(carry) and carry < 0

# --- Forward Carry (63d ahead) ---
# Use lead operator, NOT forward_returns (carry near zero → division by zero)
fwd_carry_63 = carry << 63

# --- Regime-Filtered Forward Carry ---
backwd_fwd = where(is_backwardation, fwd_carry_63)
contango_fwd = where(is_contango, fwd_carry_63)

# --- Hit Rate: does carry stay same sign next quarter? ---
# In backwardation: hit if forward carry is also positive
backwd_hit = where(is_backwardation, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_carry_63) and fwd_carry_63 > 0) else 0.0)
# In contango: hit if forward carry is also negative
contango_hit = where(is_contango, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_carry_63) and fwd_carry_63 < 0) else 0.0)

# --- Regime Flip Detection (for event markers) ---
flip_to_backwd = crossover(carry, 0)
flip_to_contango = crossunder(carry, 0)
is_flip = flip_to_backwd or flip_to_contango
flip_carry = where(is_flip, carry)
flip_regime = where(is_flip, conditional_select(flip_to_backwd, "Backwardation", "Contango"))

# --- Output 1: Scatter — Current Carry vs 63d Forward Carry ---
# The punchline: tight diagonal = carry persists, scattered = unpredictable
xy_scatter(
    title='Does Current Carry Predict Next Quarter?',
    x_axis_label='Current Carry (Front - Back)',
    y_axis_label='Carry 63 Days Ahead',
    category='Term Structure Persistence',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=4,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=carry, y_values=fwd_carry_63)

# --- Output 2: Bars — Median Forward Carry by Regime ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Median Next-Quarter Carry by Current Regime',
    category='Term Structure Persistence',
    y_axis_label='Median 63d Forward Carry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(backwd_fwd, contango_fwd))

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Regime Statistics ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry Regime Persistence Stats (63d Forward)',
        row_size=4, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['N (Daily Obs)', 'Median Fwd Carry', 'Persistence Rate', 'Worst Fwd Carry'],
        col_headers=['Backwardation', 'Contango'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='Term Structure Persistence',
    order=3
)(backwd_fwd, contango_fwd, backwd_hit, contango_hit, backwd_fwd, contango_fwd, backwd_fwd, contango_fwd)

# --- Event Markers: Regime Flips ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Carry Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry at Flip', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='New Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(flip_carry, flip_regime, is_flip)
